t: Im nashim uqetannim chayyabim bebirkat hammazon
s: Im nashim uqetannim chayyabim bebirkat hammazon, ubo d' seipim: nashim chayyabot bebirkat hammazon, vesapeq hu im chayyabot min hattora mippene shehu mitzvat aseh sheen hazzeman gerama, o enan chayyabot ella middibre soperim, mippene shenneemar "al haaretz hattoba asher natan lak", vehaaretz lo nittena linqebot lehitchalleq ella lizkarim, ubenot tzelopchad cheleq abihem natelu shehaya miyyotzee mitzrayim. Abal kohanim uleviyyim hayu lahem are migrash. Veken ger shenniknas ledat yisrael venilva alehem venitpal alehem venechshab keechad mehem lekol hammitzvot hannohagot bahem velahem nittena haaretz lemorasha — nitchayyeb gam hu keillu nittena gam lo, shehu vehem am echad hu lekol dabar, mah sheen ken benashim shehem am bipne atzmo. Veken kohanim uleviyyim, im lo haya lahem are migrash — lo hayu mitchayyebim bemitzva zo, mippene shennittena haaretz leyisrael, lepi shehem shebet bipne atzman veenam tepelim leyisrael, vegam hem chaluqim mehem bemitzvot harbeh. Vaabadim sheenam meshuchrarim, ap al pi shehen zekarim — enam kegerim, ella kenashim, kemo shellamedu chakamim al abadim bigzera shava "lah" "lah" meishsha, shekkol mitzva shehaishsha petura gam haebed patur, kemo shennitbaer besiman m"v:

Vesapeq shel tora lehachamir, leinyan shehen enan motziot yede choba et haanashim hachayyabim min hattora, ki shemma hen peturot min hattora, vekol mi sheeno mechuyyab baddabar eno motzi acherim yede chobatan. Abal ish sheeno mechuyyab baddabar min hattora, kegon shello akal kede sebia — yakol lehotzi hannashim sheakelu kede sebia, kemo sheyyakol lehotzi et haanashim sheakelu kede sebia, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"z:

Veken ishsha motzia et haish shello akal kede sebia, vaapillu hi gam ken lo okla kede sebia, shemmikkol maqom hi mechuyyebet middibre soperim kemoto, veken motzia et haqqatan shehu chayyab middibre soperim kede lechanneko bemitzvot. Abal haqqatan eno motzi et haishsha sheokla kede sebia, shemma hi mechuyyebet min hattora, abal motzi hu et mi shello akal kede sebia apillu hu i[yash] , kevan sheeno chayyab min hattora ella middibre soperim, vaapillu im haqqatan gam ken lo akal kede sebia, shemmikkol maqom hu chayyab middibre soperim kemoto, shebbirkat hammazon enah doma limgilla vehallel ubirkot qeriat shema ushear mitzvot sheiqqaran middibre soperim, sheen haqqatan shehiggia lechinnuk motzi et haggadol, lepi shehaqqatan mitztzad atzmo keshehu atta patur legamre ella shemmechannekin oto kede sheyyehe ragil bemitzva zo veyihyeh sarik keminhago kesheyyigdal, lepikak eno bedin sheyyotzi et mi shehu gadol kebar ap al pi shechiyyubo eno ella middibre soperim, kevan shehaqqatan gam chiyyub zeh eno chayyab ella mishshum lehargilo liksheyyigdal, sheaz yitchayyeb chiyyub zeh shel dibre soperim, abal bebirkat hammazon mah shemmechannekin et haqqatan lebarek achar akilato lasoba kesheyyigdal shehu chiyyub min hattora, lepikak, keshem shehu motzi et haggadol shello akal kede sebia im hu akal kede sebia — kak motzio im lo akal kede sebia, kevan shechinnuko keshello akal kede sebia moil lo lehargilo kemo kesheakal (ve)yoter:

Vekol zeh shennashim uqetannim motziim acherim yede chobatan hu, kesheacher eno yodea lebarek beatzmo, abal hayyodea lebarek beatzmo — eno rashshay latzet bishmia apillu mehamchuyyab kemoto, ella al yede zimmun bishlosha, venashim uqetannim en mezammenin alehem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"g, shehem en mebarekin bezimmun:
